header.title: Search saved creator profiles in one request.
header.description: Add multiple Instagram usernames, review which creators are already stored in the platform, and open a complete view for each match.

input.title: Search creators by username
input.tooltip: Paste a list, press Enter, or separate usernames with commas. You can also paste Instagram profile URLs. Before the search runs, usernames are normalized to lowercase and any leading @ or supported profile URL is converted automatically into the username.
input.label: Instagram usernames
input.staleBadge: Input changed, search again to refresh

validation.invalidRule: Use lowercase letters, numbers, periods or underscores, up to 30 characters.
validation.overflow: You can search up to 50 usernames per request.

panel.title: Matching profiles
panel.descriptionIdle: Saved creator profiles will appear here once you run a search.
panel.descriptionActive: Review saved profiles, open the full detail view, and generate reports from this panel.

idle.title: No results to show yet.
idle.description: Add usernames in the left panel and run a search to populate this view.

empty.title: No creator snapshots matched this search.
empty.description: Try another set of usernames or verify that those creators are already available in the saved creator data.

expired.title: Profiles need updates
expired.description: These creators exist in saved data, but their stored profile data needs to be updated. They are highlighted in yellow above and in the results list so you can identify which saved profiles need to be refreshed.

missing.title: Usernames not found
missing.description: These usernames were not found in the saved creator data. They are also highlighted in red above.

errors.duplicateActiveJob: An active scrape job already exists for these usernames.

dialog.title: Queries
dialog.description: Your latest scrape jobs, newest first. Open a finished job to review its results.

dialog.title: Search history
dialog.description: Reuse any of the last 20 successful ready username lists.

filters.title: Shape your creator
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by keyword, niche, or creator style
filters.searchHint: Type 3 or more characters to include text search in the request.

categoryDialog.title: Select categories
categoryDialog.description: These are the creator categories currently available in the catalog.
categoryDialog.empty: No categories have been added to this filter yet.

roleDialog.title: Select roles
roleDialog.description: These are the creator roles currently available in the catalog.
roleDialog.empty: No roles have been added to this filter yet.

rangeDialog.title: Select the range
rangeDialog.description: Use a creator size preset or define a manual follower range.
rangeDialog.empty: No range has been added to this filter yet.
rangeDialog.manualDescription: You can use minimum, maximum, or both. Minimum starts at 1 by default.

sortDialog.title: Select the order
sortDialog.description: These options mirror the current search endpoint contract exactly.

updateQueue.title: Ready for update
updateQueue.description: Keep profiles here while you continue browsing. When ready, send them to refresh jobs.
updateQueue.empty: Profiles marked for update will appear here.
updateQueue.limitError: You can queue up to {{max}} profiles for update.

results.title: Explore
results.idleTitle: Run a search to explore saved creators.
results.idleDescription: Apply filters and click search to populate this panel with real profiles.
results.emptyDescription: Try another combination of filters or broaden the follower range.
results.errorFallback: Unable to load creator search results.

directoryPaywall.title: Unlock the creators directory
directoryPaywall.description: Browse creators by category, role, and follower range. Activate your subscription to explore the full directory.

completed.title: Scrape completed
completed.fallback: The Instagram scrape job completed successfully.

card.noBiography: No biography available for this creator.

analysis.title: AI analysis
analysis.description: Saved content categories and creator roles associated with this profile.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Metrics documented at the time of the query. Engagement Rate (ER) expresses the share of interactions relative to the audience or to plays, depending on the format. Average ER summarizes the typical performance per saved piece, while overall ER reflects the aggregated behavior of the full queried set.
metrics.empty: No metrics were saved for this creator yet.

posts.description_one: Saved posts from {{count}} update, latest on {{date}}.
posts.description_other: Saved posts from {{count}} updates, latest on {{date}}.

reels.description_one: Saved reels from {{count}} update, latest on {{date}}.
reels.description_other: Saved reels from {{count}} updates, latest on {{date}}.

detail.loadingDescription: Fetching the latest saved profile snapshot.
